jobs.title: Lockfile Pin Delta
jobs.summary: Compare npm package-lock.json pins (name, version, integrity, resolved) and emit a pin delta.
jobs.notes: npm lockfileVersion 2 or 3 only. HTML, package.json-only, yarn/pnpm/bun, and SAMPLE-as-customer refuse. No npm install or network.

jobs.title: JSON Schema Webhook Drift
jobs.summary: Compare used JSON Pointers on JSON Schema or webhook-example JSON. Not OpenAPI.
jobs.notes: Not OpenAPI. OpenAPI documents refuse not-this-job-openapi. Remote $ref is refused. Compatible weakening is analysis, not a crash.

jobs.title: Route Table Diff
jobs.summary: Diff two JSON route catalogs and write added, removed, and changed routes. Does not edit published shells.
jobs.notes: --out-dir is required. SAMPLE is not the published SDS route table. Homepage rewrite is refused. Loopback HTTP only; no public fetch.

jobs.title: Page Change Offline Job
jobs.summary: Compare two already-held extract-batch JSON files on selected fields. Does not fetch or pay.
jobs.notes: --example is refused (sample_as_delivered_watch). Supply a held job document. Clock is required. This job never re-fetches. Not a hosted extract endpoint.

jobs.title: API Upgrade Brief
jobs.summary: Compare before/after OpenAPI against used-operation pins and emit an upgrade brief.
jobs.notes: Fixture/sample OpenAPI only; not a runtime compatibility proof.

jobs.title: Vendor Budget Impact
jobs.summary: Scan curated pricing-row before/after JSON for field and unit deltas. No purchase authority.
jobs.notes: Conflicting/unknown upstream evidence stays partial even without a known delta.

jobs.title: Feed Agenda
jobs.summary: Turn RSS/Atom before/after deltas into an agenda JSON plus ICS.
jobs.notes: Sample feed deltas only; not live deadlines.

jobs.title: Evidence CI Annotation
jobs.summary: Format a schema-compatible evidence packet into GitHub-style CI annotations.
jobs.notes: Caller-supplied schema-compatible packets remain unattested; never treated as kit-produced trusted action.

jobs.title: Listing Repair Packet
jobs.summary: Diagnose listing/route snapshots into a source-linked owner repair packet.
jobs.notes: Partial/incomplete evidence stays non-final; no global unlisting claim.

jobs.title: Repeat Job Record
jobs.summary: Build an operator-schedulable next-run record with local byte verification. Not a daemon.
jobs.notes: Declared digests must match local file bytes for verified identity; missing files stay informational/unverified.
